tool_input.command:
set -e -o pipefail
echo "=== my own identity ==="; echo "shell pid=$$ ppid=$PPID"; ps -o pid,ppid,pgid,lstart,command -p $$ 2>/dev/null; echo; echo "=== ancestry of my shell ==="; p=$PPID; for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6; do [ -z "$p" ] || [ "$p" = "0" ] || [ "$p" = "1" ] && break; ps -o pid,ppid,pgid,lstart,command -p "$p" 2>/dev/null | tail -n +2; p=$(ps -o ppid= -p "$p" 2>/dev/null | tr -d ' '); done
tool_input.description: Identify my own process and ancestry
